notes.title: New game page on Steam - Primordial Genesis
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43349548/48a4478e30d6335f56ab39e59d7d4fabf3059575.png[/img]

Hi everyone! The Steam page for my new game - Primordial Genesis, is now open. It's a sci-fi psychological horror presented in the form of a kinetic visual novel. You can find more about this game on the Primordial Genesis Steam page. The game is still in development, and I am currently working on a demo version, which I hope will be finished soon.

Steam page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2822650/Primordial_Genesis/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2822650/Primordial_Genesis/[/url]
Official page: [url=https://mmmindiegames.blogspot.com/]https://mmmindiegames.blogspot.com/[/url]

Regarding the game development itself, I handle the music, story, and coding on my own, while for the graphics, I use digital art created by AI. I understand that AI art carries a certain stigma, so the game's price will be minimal. Just earning enough to purchase the Steam page for the next visual novel will be enough for me. And of course, if "Primordial Genesis" brings in more revenue, that revenue will be invested in hiring real digital artists for the game's graphics. The reason for using AI digital art is that my current financial situation does not allow me to hire a human graphic designer, which I hope will change in the future. Unfortunately, I also lack the talent to create the digital art needed to effectively tell the story of "Primordial Genesis." And that's what it's all about. I just want to tell the story that has been within me for a long time. I've tried to tell it in different ways, but I believe that this method through a visual novel is the best way.

If you enjoy sci-fi psychological horror, I hope you can overlook the use of A.I. digital art and still appreciate a story that attempts to explore the question of why people desire immortality and what immortality means for organisms like us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43349548/73958558aa5f6b5f3fa34dfcb8975592182b6a26.png[/img]

You can visit the "Primordial Genesis" page on Steam and wishlist it at [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2822650/Primordial_Genesis/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2822650/Primordial_Genesis/[/url]

notes.title: Devlog - "At the Dream End 2: Beyond Gods" upcoming demo
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43349548/babbdc4b7de54c726ae8e7b808e041d41f25662f.png[/img]

Welcome to the devlog for the upcoming demo of "At the Dream End 2: Beyond Gods." We're excited to share with you a glimpse into the world of our visual novel and showcase some of the thrilling content you can expect from this sequel. In this devlog, we'll provide you with an overview of the demo, including its features, storyline, and what to look forward to.

The demo will begin with a recap of the events from "At the Dream End 1" to refresh your memory and reacquaint you with the story. You'll be able to relive the key moments and revisit the decisions that shaped the narrative. 

Also, the demo will provide part of the storyline for "At the Dream End 2: Beyond Gods." You'll be introduced to new characters, encounter intriguing challenges, and witness the evolution of the overarching plot. 

Additionally, we want to keep some surprises under wraps. The demo will feature a locked story arc titled "Quantum Genesis Station - Trinity." This locked content serves as a tantalizing glimpse of the full game's depth and will leave you eager to explore further in the complete experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43349548/bd03ce64d4f0a1088700c3655021f5d1f59d0409.png[/img]

We appreciate your support and patience as we prepare to release the demo next week. Stay tuned for further updates, including the specific release date and where you can get your hands on this exciting preview of "At the Dream End 2: Beyond Gods."

The dream is about to begin once more, and we can't wait to share it with you. Thank you for your unwavering support and for being part of the "At the Dream End" community.

We are thrilled to announce that the official website for our latest game, "At the Dream End 2 - Beyond Gods," is now live! This sci-fi horror visual novel delves into the realms of biological experiments and explores what happens when humans finally uncover the source of life and the energy that granted them existence. You can find "At the Dream End 2 - Beyond Gods" official page on Steam, GameJolt, and ItchIo so be sure to visit and follow it to be among the first to receive updates about our exciting new game.

In this sequel, we dive deeper into the enigmatic lore of the Dream End universe, where the boundaries between dreams and reality blur, and the consequences of tampering with the fabric of existence are dire. 

As we embark on this journey, we want to hear from you, our community. Your feedback is of utmost importance to us, and we welcome your thoughts, ideas, and suggestions. Share your experiences, theories, and insights as you play "At the Dream End 1," the precursor to our upcoming release. Let us know what you loved, what intrigued you, and what you hope to see in "At the Dream End 2 - Beyond Gods."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43349548/aeda2b0918bf643a193f3d47facc3e39d6d0bc17.png[/img]

We are incredibly grateful for your support and enthusiasm. Together, let's embark on a journey beyond the realms of imagination, where the mysteries of life and the essence of our existence intertwine. Get ready to explore the unknown in "At the Dream End 2 - Beyond Gods"!

notes.content:
We are excited to announce that the development of the game "At the Dream End" has officially begun. To celebrate this occasion, we are thrilled to share the official teaser trailer for "Beyond God - At the Dream End 2."

Watch the "Beyond God - At the Dream End 2" teaser trailer here: 

[previewyoutube=dedHMK4SgfY;full][/previewyoutube]

Here are a few key details you need to know about this upcoming game. After careful consideration, the MMM Team has decided that future games, including "Beyond God - At the Dream End 2," will be in the style of visual novels and choose-your-own-adventure games. We believe this is the best direction for us to make players feel a dark, surreal atmosphere in the most intense way. And we hope that we didn't disappoint you with this decision. 

While we don't have further news to share about "Beyond Gods" at the moment, we encourage you to try out "At the Dream End 1" and provide us with feedback. Your input is invaluable as we strive to expand the universe of "At the Dream End" and deliver an even better gaming experience. Your feedback will play a crucial role in shaping the future of our games.

notes.title: "At the Dream End" Bonus Content PDF Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43349548/029b5b6f939e3efa0278d3a94c2d811a4586ad4e.png[/img]

Hey there, dreamers! We're excited to announce that the "At the Dream End" bonus content PDF is just around the corner and will be available for download by the end of the week. We've been working hard to bring you this extra treat for all the dedicated fans of our game. Here's a sneak peek of what you can expect to find in this exciting PDF:

Characters Info: Delve deeper into the world of "At the Dream End" with character profiles. Gain a deeper understanding of the fascinating cast of characters that brought this game to life.

Location Info: Explore the vivid and immersive environments that make up the world in "At the Dream End." Get an in-depth look at the various locations, their significance, and the stories they tell. 

Digital Art: Enjoy a collection of character designs, and beautiful landscapes. 

Walkthrough (100% Completion): Struggling to find that last hidden collectible or solve a particularly challenging puzzle? Fear not! Our comprehensive walkthrough will guide you through every step of the game, ensuring you achieve 100% completion. No secret will remain undiscovered.

Early Version of "At the Dream End" Story: Step back in time and witness the evolution of the game's narrative. We'll provide you with a glimpse into the early drafts and concepts that shaped the story. Compare and contrast the changes made along the way and gain insight into the creative process behind "At the Dream End."

Sneak Peek into "Beyond Gods - At the Dream End 2": Brace yourselves for an exclusive sneak peek into our upcoming project, "Beyond Gods - At the Dream End 2." Get a taste of what's to come, a glimpse into the next chapter of this ever-growing universe.

And the best part? The "At the Dream End" bonus content PDF will be completely free! We want to express our gratitude to all the fans who supported us on this incredible journey. This PDF is our way of saying thank you and giving back to the community that made it all possible.

We hope you enjoy this bonus content as much as we enjoyed creating it for you. Until then, keep dreaming, and we'll see you at the dream end!

notes.title: Devlog - Future Plans for MMM Games
notes.content:
It's been an exciting week since the release of our first game, "At the Dream End," on Steam. We are extremely grateful for the feedback and reviews we have received so far. It has been an incredible journey for us, and we are determined to continue improving and creating games that resonate with our players.

Our next step is to create a PDF document that includes behind-the-scenes material, artwork, and bonus content for our fans of "At the Dream End." This PDF will be available for free and will be a way for us to connect with our community.

notes.title: Exploring the Universe of "At the Dream End". - Release date: 28/04/2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43349548/bd492f4b11ebfc7e7e185684a8dd2231f43d359e.png[/img]

As our first Steam game's release date draws nearer (28/04/2023), we will be sharing more details about the expansive universe in which the game is set, as well as our ambitious plans for future installments in the series.

Our vision for this series is to create a vast dark sci-fi universe where each story stands on its own, but all of them are interconnected. Each game will feature unique characters, settings, and storylines, but they will all be set in the same universe, allowing players to discover more about the lore and history of this world as they play.

One of the central themes of our universe is the concept of energy. In this universe, humans understand that the energy that gives them life is a fundamental force of the universe. They've developed technologies to harness this energy, but they're constantly discovering new ways to use it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43349548/ab28675d0721f0f1deaf304657bb3aeca79cf4d6.png[/img]

In the first game of our series, "At the Dream End," we introduced the concept of angels – beings that exist outside of our physical world. These angels are a mysterious force that humans are only beginning to understand, and they play a pivotal role in the game's story.

But the angels are just the beginning. As we develop more games in this series, we plan to introduce new and exciting concepts that explore the depths of our universe. At the heart of our universe is the idea that the more we discover about the energy that drives us, the more we realize how little we truly understand. We hope that players will be captivated by the mysteries of this universe and feel compelled to keep exploring, year after year.

We're excited to continue developing the "At the Dream End" universe and can't wait to share more about it in the coming months. Stay tuned for more updates on our progress and the stories we have in store!

notes.title: At the Dream End - 28/04/2023
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=E3eZIfIEQcI;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello gamers!

We're excited to announce that our upcoming game, "At The Dream End," is almost ready to be released! Here's what you need to know about it.

At the heart of the "At the Dream End" game is the story. The game takes place in a world where scientists have conducted bio experiments on animals, mainly wolves, to infuse them with a new form of energy that gives us life. What is the origin of that energy is a mystery even for the sciences themselves. 

The story is divided into three chapters.

In the first chapter, you will play as a wolf while in the second and third chapters, you'll play as a young scientist whose life energy has been transferred into a wolf's body as a result of the experiments. After the life energy transfer, you set out to stop a person on the verge of destroying the planet. A person addressed as Butcher.

As for the gameplay, it is simple. Players will need to explore their environment, find key items, and solve puzzles to progress.

MMM Team has been hard at work creating a dark sci-fi story with an incredible surreal atmosphere that we believe will captivate and engage players. The sci-fi setting allowed us to create a world that felt both futuristic and foreign, where the rules of reality are constantly being pushed to their limits. We hope that players will find themselves lost in this world, discovering new secrets and unraveling the mystery that lies at its core.

These objects are scattered throughout the game world, and by collecting all of them, the player will unlock hidden areas that will provide a deeper understanding of the story and the world.

We hope that these additions will enhance the player's experience and deepen their connection to the game world. We're working hard to create a game that is both immersive and engaging, and these features are an important step in that direction.

notes.title: We are introducing the Owl Brothers Mini-Boss Fight
notes.content:
We are introducing the Owl Brothers Mini-Boss Fight

We are excited to announce the addition of a new and unique mini-boss fight in our game - the Owl Brothers. Instead of a traditional physical battle, players will engage in a dialog-based confrontation with these powerful owls.

The Owl Brothers will appear at a specific level of the game, and players will need to use their wits and persuasion skills to defeat them. The dialog choices players make will determine the outcome of the battle, and players will need to choose their words carefully in order to come out victorious.

As with any boss fight, the Owl Brothers will be a challenging obstacle for players. Additionally, the Owl Brothers can result in a Game Over screen if players are not successful in the dialog battle. This adds an extra layer of tension and excitement to the game, as players will need to be fully prepared before engaging with them.

We are looking forward to players' reactions to this unique and engaging mini-boss fight and how it will add to the overall gameplay experience.

In addition to the new mini-boss fight, we are also excited to announce that we are currently working on a new gameplay trailer that will showcase the new features of the game. The trailer will be coming soon, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Introduction
notes.content:
Hi everyone! My name is Martin and I am an indie developer from Serbia (part of an MMM team). I created a few games in Game Maker Studio 2 but I always wanted to make horror, melancholy, and atmospheric games in an old SNES style. Game Maker Studio 2 can do that but it's a lot of work. I found myself thinking more about the code than anything else. Then I found RPG Maker MZ. And since this engine doesn't require almost any coding, it allowed me to focus on more important things in my project. Story and atmosphere. And so, here I am with my first RPG Maker project called "At the dream end".

DEMO is coming soon! In the meantime you can read short "At the dream end story" at [url=https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2251670/manuals/At_the_dream_end_short_story.pdf?t=1671260821]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2251670/manuals/At_the_dream_end_short_story.pdf?t=1671260821[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43349548/2a1aeef466e1fb691e752e6ef10bed2ba365b85b.png[/img]

[b]More about MMM team:[/b]

We are a team of writers and game developers from Serbia. We create short, dark stories/games with equally dark digital art. The goal is to introduce readers to melancholy and often brutal worlds, if only for a short time. If you are a fan of dark imagery, and depressing stories, you are in the right place! You can contact us at markovic.martin887@gmail.com
